name.value: Brentwood Bay Village Empourium Café & Gift Shop

description.value: A café, bakery, and gift shop in Brentwood Bay Village, twice voted Greater Victoria's Favourite Coffee Shop by Times Colonist readers (2023 and 2025). The all-day kitchen turns out breakfast sandwiches, hot paninis, house-made soups, and a rotating selection of baked goods, alongside a curated range of locally sourced gifts and merchandise. The licensed premises also offers catering and can host on-site gatherings for up to 30 guests.

address.value: Unit 12, 7103 West Saanich Rd (partial — address truncated on website), Brentwood Bay, BC

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, award-winning café with hot food, baked goods, and takeout options in Brentwood Bay — a popular cycling destination on the Saanich Peninsula — making it a practical and appealing rest stop for touring cyclists.
